title: The Last Cake Before Dawn
summary: On the eve of the princess's wedding, a baker and her apprentice worked through the night on an enormous towering cake, racing the sunrise. Drawn by the scent of honey and spun sugar, a starving giant who had been driven from the hills by a failed harvest smashed through the kitchen wall. In a panic the pair tried to scare, then bribe it, and finally lured it away with the cake itself, leaving a trail of crumbs and flour into the woods. The player pieces together that the giant never meant harm, and that the baker's last frantic act was one of kindness, not flight.
